Explanation:  
The question requires adding up the numbers in the postcode of the hospital where John Lennon was born. The Ground Truth Answer is 14. The Predicted Answer states the postcode as "L7" and sums only the single digit 7, producing an answer of 7, which is incorrect. Historically, the postcode for Liverpool Maternity Hospital (where John Lennon was born) is "L7 8XP" (or similar), and summing the numbers 7 + 8 would yield 15. It is possible that the ground truth answer used a different variant (such as "L14", which sums to 14), but regardless, the predicted answer only includes part of the postcode and omits at least one numeric digit, thus not matching the substance of the ground truth.

Decision: FALSE
